hero.title: Aleksandra Mikhailova — Frontend Developer
hero.subtitle: Building fast, accessible interfaces with React, TypeScript, and Vue.js.

about.heading: About me
about.p1: Hi! I'm Aleksandra, a frontend developer with 6+ years of experience. I specialize in building complex web interfaces and SPAs with React and Vue.js, using TypeScript.
about.p2: My background includes both frontend and backend work (PHP, Laravel, MySQL). This helps me understand the full picture and collaborate effectively with backend teams.
about.p3: Lately I focus on React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I care about reusable components and web accessibility (a11y).
about.languages: Languages: Russian — native, English — Pre-Intermediate (I read technical docs, write code in English fluently, spoken English is basic).

skills.heading: Tech stack
skills.frontend_list: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React, Vue.js (2/3, Composition API), Vue Router, Pinia, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, jQuery
skills.backend_list: PHP, Laravel, Yii2, REST API, MySQL, PostgreSQL

projects.heading: Projects
projects.public_desc: A single-page application built with React. Supports English/Russian languages, dark/light theme, animations, and responsive design. Demonstrates i18n, accessibility, and performance optimization.
projects.public_tech: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, react-i18next
projects.nda_notice: Most of my commercial projects are internal university systems. They are not publicly available, but I can describe them in an interview.
projects.corporate_1_desc: React + TypeScript frontend for teacher workload distribution. Features complex dynamic tables, drag-and-drop, form validation. Integrated with Laravel API. Reduced planning time by 40%.
projects.corporate_1_tech: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Laravel, MySQL
projects.corporate_2_desc: Responsive dashboard with personal data, payslips, and vacation schedule. Built with Vue.js and PHP (Yii2). Handles hundreds of concurrent users.
